title: Damped Spring Team: Bond Vigilantes vs. Policy BS

excerpts.label: Can't BS the bond market
excerpts.insight: Back-end yields at range highs with zero support—July/Sept gaps left cliff edge. Bond vigilantes can't be jawboned when yields this fragile.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: WATCH 10Y/30Y—break = waterfall. Geneva rally predicated on BS, jumped resistance on vapor. If admin ignores bonds and dumps through levels, equities follow. No support underneath.

excerpts.label: How do you stop bond selloff?
excerpts.insight: Can't jawbone long-end when floating 'easy Fed' picks. That ADDS pressure. Need spending cuts, tax hikes, or recession to rally bonds.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Bond vigilantes force discipline—no BS playbook. Issuance wall + AI infrastructure = supply problem. Only fixes: reconciliation cuts, legal tariffs, or slowing economy.

excerpts.label: Deflationary impulse Q1-Q2
excerpts.insight: OBB kicking in, tax cuts, Fed cutting cycle. Lagged rent adjustments + Venezuela oil + low gas prices = transitory disinflationary force in numbers.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Short-term disinflation gives Fed cover for cuts. Market wrong on "inflationary decade"—headline CPI tailwinds, oil cooperating. Buy dips in stock indices on this backdrop.

excerpts.label: Hassett pick = bond dump
excerpts.insight: Waller best pick (dovish + credible), Hassett instant yield spike, Worsh unclear. Charts have no wiggle room—mistake kicks over edge.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Waller = BUY bonds. Hassett = SELL everything. Besset likely telling Trump can't do Hassett where bond market sits. DXY stabilizing after Hassett balloon downtrend = first tea leaf of backoff.

excerpts.label: Fed underpricing cuts 50-75bps
excerpts.insight: 55bps priced through June, team expects 75-100bps. SOFR trough north of 3.0% too restrictive. Lagged disinflation + softer employment = Fed cover.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY SOFR—clear misprice. Unemployment ticking up (Sahm rule proximity), housing semi-locked needs easing. Fed wants to stay ahead of it. 2-3 cuts coming, market only pricing 1-2.

excerpts.label: Equity concentration = tail risk
excerpts.insight: $2T Mag 7 can't rotate to small caps without disrupting price. Selloffs flow to bonds/commodities. Concentration = FOMO extension + crash vulnerability.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Raise cash on rallies. 10% earnings growth supports dip-buying, but NO rotation saves index if AI names dump. Liquidity physics—flows exit to bonds/commodities, not cyclicals.

excerpts.label: Gold FOMO above $3700
excerpts.insight: Russia annexation fears drove gold to $3500-3700. Above that = FOMO blowoff in small market. Historical parabolic tops: post-GFC, Hunt Bros.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: PASS gold at $4000+. Silver even worse. Central bank buying + retail piling in small market = outsized moves, not macro deficit signal. Reversal risk extreme.

excerpts.label: Oil $56 screaming buy setup
excerpts.insight: Venezuela news tonight likely gap down. $56 critical support—hold + bounce = bad news/good price action. Inflation-adjusted $50 historical floor.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: OIL screaming buy if holds $55-56 and reverses. Daily close under $56 = test $50, maybe $40s. Saudi deal temporary. Wait for bounce confirmation before entry.

excerpts.label: SCOTUS tariff = steepener trade
excerpts.insight: If illegal, massive steepener—bond market won't believe 50-150 day workarounds. Stock investors might buy it; bond market won't. What's 6 months to 30Y?
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STEEPENERS highest conviction if SCOTUS strikes down. 2s10s/2s30s to 120-250bp range. Legal alternatives time-limited—bonds price 10-30Y duration, not patches. Team consensus: BUY if tariffs ruled illegal.
